summary: Cavite 2nd District representative with 239 principal-authored bills. Authored a daily wage increase, stronger security of tenure, paid leave for a family member's serious illness, VAT exemption on electricity, expanded employment anti-discrimination for women, OFW legal assistance, criminalization of fake news and regulation of social media use by minors.
